theorems.name: Submission.gaussGreenRep_riesz_on_open
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (Λ : (Rn N → Rn N) → ℝ), IsOpen U → (∀ g h : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → tsupport h ⊆ U → Λ (g + h) = Λ g + Λ h) → (∀ (c : ℝ) (g : Rn N → Rn N), Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ (c • g) = c * Λ g) → (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → tsupport g ⊆ K → (∀ x, ‖g x‖ ≤ 1) → Λ g ≤ C) → ∃ (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N), μ Uᶜ = 0 ∧ (∀ K : Set (Rn N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ‖ν x‖ = 1) ∧ ∀ g : Rn N → Rn N, Continuous g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ U → Λ g = ∫ x, inner ℝ (g x) (ν x) ∂μ
